intent: Regression test (PR #2600) for leader/follower divergence with named bound SQL parameters: confirms a leader write round-trips correctly and journals the inlined SQL literal rather than the raw placeholder text, and exercises the same path through RemoteSQLite.

objects.name: BoundParametersTest::queryServer
objects.role: runs a JSON-format Query and deserializes the SQResult

objects.name: BoundParametersTest::getCommitCount
objects.role: reads a node's Status commit count

objects.name: BoundParametersTest::readJournalText
objects.role: reads and decompresses one journal row's query text for a given commit ID

objects.name: BoundParametersTest::testBoundParamReplication
objects.role: writes a bound-param value on leader, waits for followers to catch up, checks the replicated row and journal text on every node

objects.name: BoundParametersTest::testRemoteSQLiteForwardsParams
objects.role: writes and reads back a row through RemoteSQLite with bound params, checking values didn't bind to NULL
